title: Whitelist public live Helius warning codes
objective: Replace permissive Helius-prefixed error passthrough with one shared exact allowlist for CA-first reads and both CLIs. Preserve known safe operational codes, normalize HTTP status errors, and map every unknown or arbitrary error to one fixed unavailable code.
forbidden_actions: Do not call Helius or any network provider in tests.
Do not expose arbitrary error text, credentials, raw payloads or credential-bearing URLs.
Do not add providers, fallback, discovery, automation, persistence, cache, queue, address-library writes, BSC or Robinhood behavior.
